items.text: Terry McLaurin now likely to miss Sunday in London vs Colts despite initial hope to play through hamstring (was Q).
items.why: Sources: hamstring flared; late add to report.
items.implication: Commanders WR void with Daniels already OUT.

items.text: Colts downgraded WR Keenan Allen to OUT for London game vs Commanders due to groin; elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine.
items.implication: Colts WR thin (Pierce also out); more to Downs/Warren/TE.

items.text: Nico Collins IN returning from hamstring; Levitan flags excellent DvP vs Cowboys (inflates WR scoring 7.3% most in NFL) and high implied points.
items.why: Full practice Friday, off report; Rapoport confirmed good to go.
items.implication: Elite WR1 in smash spot; Texans offense upgrade.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday return from hip/groin after missing time; Levitan notes great to have him back but speculation on possible snap limits.
items.why: Off injury report, McVay expects play; full practices progressive.
items.implication: WR1 return boosts Rams offense vs Eagles; monitor limits.
items.opportunity: High route/target share expected if full go; Adams/Kittle secondary.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ruled OUT for Sunday with ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle sprain from prior week; final report.
items.implication: Major Vikings WR void home vs Dolphins.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday vs Rams due to hamstring.
items.implication: Eagles pass game depleted with Goedert also out.

items.text: Ladd McConkey QUESTIONABLE (foot): LP-DNP-LP trend; already had cracked rib this season.
items.implication: Monitor for ACTIVE/INACTIVE; Chargers WR impact.

items.text: Jordan Addison opportunity spikes with Justin Jefferson OUT; home vs borderline secondary. Moment Addison truthers waited for.
items.implication: Strong WR2/flex start; target share surge.

items.text: Eagles situation worse without DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun vs Rams.
items.implication: Hurts/WRs less efficient; reverse prior beneficiaries if any IN.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest); tough early runout with GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, Charbonnet back practicing. Still long-term upside.
LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Top-10 play.
LOVE Jeremiyah Love: 26 touches (outpaced W1-2 combined), RB5 util; Giants allow 5.1 YPC; double-digit target share every game.
HATE Omarion Hampton: low util (RB27), 3.5% tgts, 25% routes, snaps to 42%, 13% 3rd down; SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
LOVE Drake London: 35% tgt share/104 ypg career w/ Penix; 43.5% last week; NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
